correction_to_001: Withdraw statement that R2/R3 are both restored on normal return. The 32-byte frame allocates the saved-R2 stack slot as the fifth stack argument; on the normal path POP R2 therefore returns R12−1. Early exits before writing that argument retain incoming R2; the special second-call path stores zero. R3 remains restored. 002 states this correctly.
